Package dev.turboism.sdk.plugin

Interface PluginContext

public interface PluginContext
Runtime context provided to a plugin during TurboismPlugin.init(PluginContext).

Optional surfaces keep throwing defaults unless their SDK contract defines an existing unavailable singleton; those surfaces return that singleton here for safe-mode compatibility.

    • logger

      PluginLogger logger()
      Returns the framework logger scoped to the current plugin.

      Every record automatically carries the plugin descriptor id and is written to Turboism's session log and, when available, Cubism's host logger.

      Returns:
      the current plugin's logger

    • mcpConnections

      default McpConnectionService mcpConnections()
      Returns the process-local authenticated MCP connection exchange.

      The runtime permission-scopes publication and reads independently. Authorization material obtained through this service must not be logged or persisted by plugins.

      Returns:
      the current plugin's MCP connection service
